name: Village pig
summary: Named at Hang Kia as lợn bản. The 2019 feature says thịt heo bản, grilled beside the sticky rice. Both names stay as the sources wrote them.
origin: The rural-tourism feature for Hang Kia, and the 2019 Vĩnh Long feature for thịt heo bản.
howToEat: Grilled, beside xôi, on the 2019 feature. A Hang Kia method is Check on arrival.
where: Hang Kia. Thai villages on the 2019 feature.
